# Teerth Sharma: Seal's Topology Land

> A playable 3D ice island at https://www.evilseal.si. A baby seal slides to each stop, and every stop is a project by Teerth Sharma: a contribution merged into an open-source project, or a lab project. The island is a WebGL canvas, so each stop also has a plain-text page, listed below.

Canonical origin: https://www.evilseal.si
Sitemap: https://www.evilseal.si/sitemap.xml

## About

A twenty year old tech lover who likes turning maths and ideas into solid code. Some of those ideas now live inside the codebases of companies like these.

The island is built with Next.js, React, React Three Fiber and Three.js. Each project page has its own title, description and structured data.

## Contact and profiles

- GitHub: https://github.com/teerthsharma
- Website: https://teerthsharma.github.io/
- Resume (PDF): https://github.com/teerthsharma/teerthsharma/raw/main/Teerth_Sharma_Resume.pdf

## Upstream contributions

Merged into the open-source projects named here. Each page gives the result and links the pull request.

- [1,281.6x less scratch](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-mujoco-3396): google-deepmind/mujoco #3396. 84,033,568 bytes to 65,568 at ntree 4,096. 1,281.6x less.
  Pull request: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/pull/3396
- [1.513x faster](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-mujoco-warp-1541): google-deepmind/mujoco_warp #1541. 156.738 us to 101.097 us. Scratch 7,929,856 bytes to 180,224.
  Pull request: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_warp/pull/1541
- [15,361x fewer probes](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-mujoco-3450): google-deepmind/mujoco #3450. 16 lines added. 15,361x fewer probes at V=40,962. Cold load 134.400 ms to 71.163 ms.
  Pull request: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/pull/3450
- [65.5x fewer comparisons](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-highway-3244): google/highway #3244. 894,081,141 comparisons to 13,643,737 at one million keys. 65.5x.
  Pull request: https://github.com/google/highway/pull/3244
- [6.42% lower peak](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-xnnpack-10801): google/XNNPACK #10801. MobileNet V1 peak 23.862980 to 22.331730 MiB. Workspace 144 MiB to 112 MiB.
  Pull request: https://github.com/google/XNNPACK/pull/10801
- [4 edges to 3](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-tensorflow-124410): tensorflow/tensorflow #124410. Four control edges emitted where the unique transitive reduction is three.
  Pull request: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/124410
- [23 files](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-nemo-relay-481): NVIDIA/NeMo-Relay #481. One unchanging scaffold now keys to one profile instead of one per task. 23 files.
  Pull request: https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Relay/pull/481
- [804 lines added](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-triton-kernels-22): triton-lang/kernels #22. A topology derived sparse attention kernel. 804 lines added, 17 tests passing.
  Pull request: https://github.com/triton-lang/kernels/pull/22
- [5 lines, deterministic](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-openxla-46539): openxla/xla #46539. Five lines. Same program, two outputs before, one stable output after. XLA compiles for JAX and TensorFlow.
  Pull request: https://github.com/openxla/xla/pull/46539
- [145 lines gated](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-topograph-432): dsx-ai-factory/topograph #432. 145 lines changed across 4 files. pods, nodes and daemonsets access no longer granted cluster wide.
  Pull request: https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/topograph/pull/432
- [208 SCCs pinned](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-pyrefly-4180): facebook/pyrefly #4180. 208 two-module SCCs chained in one Rust test. The failure is pinned at the end with should_panic.
  Pull request: https://github.com/facebook/pyrefly/pull/4180
- [11/11 pairs agree](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-polychrom-79): open2c/polychrom #79. 11/11 test pairs agree with the fix, 1/11 on master. pytest 65/65, up from 64/64. Mismatched frees: 16 to 0.
  Pull request: https://github.com/open2c/polychrom/pull/79
- [0 diffs in 60,000](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-anyps5-12609): boykopovar/AnyPS5 #12609. Reviewers measured 0 differences from a brute-force oracle on 60,000 random series, and 10^6 frames in 2.1 s. 79 tests passing.
  Pull request: https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pull/12609
- [0 of 35,000 off](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/pr-tensorflow-128930): tensorflow/tensorflow #128930. Master matched 8 of 18 named cases and mismatched 1,459 / 5,000 tie-rich and 8,833 / 30,000 wild inputs; after: all match. -24% at 4000x90.
  Pull request: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/128930

## Lab projects

Each lab project has its own repository, linked from its page.

- [resolvent](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-resolvent): Attention and Markov paths share one operator.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/resolvent
  Also: https://teerthsharma.github.io/resolvent/
- [Epsilon-Hollow](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-epsilon-hollow): Memory, files and scheduler, on one sphere.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/Epsilon-Hollow
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/Epsilon-Hollow#readme
- [Aether-Lang](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-aether-lang): Loops stop when their shape stops changing.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/Aether-Lang
  Also: https://teerthsharma.github.io/Aether-Lang/
- [caustic](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-caustic): Hallucination, measurable with no ground truth.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/caustic
  Also: https://teerthsharma.github.io/caustic/
- [monodromy](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-monodromy): Can it be undone? Topology answers.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/monodromy
  Also: https://teerthsharma.github.io/monodromy/
- [topological-ml-toolkit](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-topological-ml-toolkit): The shape of data, as an ordinary feature.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/topological-ml-toolkit
  Also: https://teerthsharma.github.io/topological-ml-toolkit/
- [faraday](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-faraday): The field coupling, found rather than assumed.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/faraday
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/faraday#readme
- [nerve](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-nerve): The control that could kill my result.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/nerve
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/nerve#readme
- [separatrix](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-separatrix): Decided by the data, not by rounding.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/separatrix
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/separatrix#readme
- [planimeter](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-planimeter): Exact, or refused.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/planimeter
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/planimeter#readme
- [tangle](https://www.evilseal.si/projects/p-tangle): It refuses rather than guesses.
  Repository: https://github.com/teerthsharma/tangle
  Also: https://github.com/teerthsharma/tangle#readme
